obs: "There is no rule requiring every part of the provision to apply to all classes covered by it."
Domenech v. National City Bank of NY

"We think otherwise. If Puerto Rico can and does collect taxes of any of the types mentioned in R.S. 5219, the mere fact that the situation prevents resort to one of the other kinds thereby permitted does not make the statute a nullity in the Island."
"The Court has never before suggested that all the verbs in a statute need to match up with all the nouns."
